release_notes: Butter-Smooth 60/120 FPS Scrolling: Completely eliminated jitter and frame drops across student dashboard & portal views
Instant Opening: Lazy windowed rendering for Academic Register and attendance sheets for zero-lag screen loads
Ultra-Fast Touch & Tap: Hardware-accelerated glass styling and RepaintBoundary isolation for instant ripple and navigation response
Clean Neutral Styling: Distraction-free typography, neutral pill shapes, and streamlined status presentation
